name: Inca Empire
description: The Andes' great empire, run without writing or wheels: khipu cord-records, 40,000 km of mountain roads with relay runners, terraced agriculture, freeze-dried storehouses, and monumental masonry at Cusco and Machu Picchu.

name: Aztec Empire
description: The Triple Alliance dominating central Mexico from the island capital Tenochtitlan — a city of canals and chinampa gardens larger than contemporary European capitals — with tribute economics, pictographic books, and a calendar-driven sacrificial religion.
